findings.route_reason: README build command and CI.

evidence.quote: cargo build --release without --locked
actions/checkout@v4 tag; toolchain stable unpinned

skeptic.reason: Dependencies are pinned: Cargo.lock is committed, and CI runs clippy and test with --locked. The finding's evidence leaves that out. A plain 'cargo build --release' still honours the committed lockfile; --locked only turns drift into a failure instead of a silent update. An unpinned stable toolchain and the first-party actions/checkout@v4 tag are hygiene issues, not an unpinned-dependency trap. Optional polish: add --locked to the README.

quarantine.text: a warning before editing a file another session holds
quarantine.reason: PreToolUse context lands next to the tool result, after the edit.
quarantine.replacement: The warning reaches the model when it edits a held file; a pre-edit policy is the owner's open decision (F-001).

quarantine.text: delivered in order and at least once
quarantine.reason: A daemon restart lost undelivered messages; replay window and broadcast limits apply.
quarantine.replacement: Session messages are replayed until shown; duplicates possible under the same seq; broadcast and user messages reach sessions known at arrival; replay window 100,000 events.

quarantine.text: the pre-edit check rejects writes that carry a stale token
quarantine.reason: The hub rejects stale renew/release; the hook then re-acquires and warns or reports the lapse; files are not checked.
quarantine.replacement: Stale tokens are rejected by the hub and reported to the session at its next edit.

quarantine.text: Daemon reconnects resume from the last sequence number, so no event is lost.
quarantine.reason: Not true across daemon restarts or a reset hub log before the fixes; bounded by the replay window after.
quarantine.replacement: Resume from the hub cursor kept before the oldest undelivered message; follow a hub log that went back.

quarantine.text: the daemon also watches the working tree and a git pre-commit check reports conflicts
quarantine.replacement: Shell-command edits are not checked; watcher and pre-commit check are later.

quarantine.text: channel permission relay is off by default
quarantine.reason: wormhole never declares the capability; it cannot be enabled.
